# A quiet first draft

A first draft is a place to think, not a place to be right. I write it fast, I let it wander, and I try not to fix anything while the words are still coming.

The second pass is where the work starts. Every sentence has to earn its place. Most of them do not, and that is fine.

A few habits that help:

- Read the page out loud, slowly.
- Cut the line you like the most.
- Keep the old version close, in case you want it back.

Some days the words come easily.
